name: Calcium Acetate
indications_original: Calcium acetate is a phosphate binder indicated to reduce serum phosphorus in patients with end stage renal disease (ESRD).
contraindications_original: The recommended initial dose of calcium acetate for the adult dialysis patient is 2 capsules with each meal. Increase the dose gradually to lower serum phosphorus levels to the target range, as long as hypercalcemia does not develop. Most patients require 3 to 4 capsules with each meal.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Calcium Acetate Capsules, USP 
                  
                  
                     667 mg capsule is supplied as a white opaque/blue opaque capsule, imprinted with “54 215” on the cap and body.
                  
                  Cartons of 50 capsules (10 capsules each blister pack x 5), NDC 0904-7119-06 
                  Cartons of 100 capsules (10 capsules each blister pack x 10), NDC 0904-7119-61
                  WARNING: These Unit Dose packages are not child resistant and are Intended for Institutional Use Only. Keep this and all drugs out of the reach of children.
                  
                     Storage
                  
                  Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F). [See USP Controlled Room Temperature.]
